title: Multilinear extension at sign inputs
statement: For any sign predicate $P$ and any tuple $y$ of signs indexed by its input positions, the multilinear extension of $P$'s acceptance indicator, evaluated at the real values of the signs in $y$, equals the acceptance indicator of $P$ at $y$.
hypotheses_covered: A tuple of signs indexed by the arity of P
